title: How I Audit a GoHighLevel Account — Define, Compare, Prioritize, Recommend

sections.label: 1 · DEFINE EXPECTED BEHAVIOR
sections.note: Before judging anything, I write down what each workflow is supposed to do.

sections.label: 2 · COMPARE ACTUAL VS EXPECTED
sections.note: I trace what the workflow actually does and measure it against that expectation, across every workflow in the account.

sections.label: 3 · LOG EVERY GAP
sections.note: Anywhere actual and expected don't match gets logged with its root cause.

sections.label: 4 · PRIORITIZE & RECOMMEND
sections.note: Gaps get sorted by lead-flow impact and each one gets a specific fix, not a vague note.

nodes.label: List Every Active Workflow in the Account
Define Each Workflow's Input and Expected Output
Trace What Each Workflow Actually Does, Step by Step
Compare Actual Output Against Expected Output
Measure Efficiency: Step Count, Delay Time, Drop-Off Points
Log Every Gap Found, With Its Root Cause
Sort Every Logged Gap by Lead-Flow Impact
Assign Each Gap a Fix: Quick Fix or Rebuild
Walk the Client Through Findings and Fixes

input_sample.expected_output: Lead replies or gets a human follow-up within 24 hours
input_sample.actual_output: One SMS sent, no retry, no handoff if the lead never replies

output_sample.top_priority: New Lead workflow has no 24-hour no-response branch, ranked highest impact since it sits on every incoming lead
